title: Compass and Atlas
author: Astrid Dravenmoor
blurb: Casper Iversen, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
